content.value: List the necessary assumptions of the Bernoulli distribution. An automatic traffic (10) [CO4] control system monitors video download speeds for under-speeding. Based on a previous analysis, the probability of a video being under-speeded is 0.15. In a specific time-frame, four videos are investigated. Calculate the probabilities for the following scenarios:
i) Ġreen light: No under-speeded video observed.
ii) Red light: All videos are under-speeded.
iii) Yellow light: At least one, but not all, videos are under-speeded.
